items.question: What is Logitaka Talk?
items.answer: A fullscreen voice workspace. Speak naturally and Logitaka assembles your words into structured draft cards — tasks, events, decisions, notes — in real time. Review and confirm to apply.

items.question: Does it write to my projects while I speak?
items.answer: No. Everything you see while speaking is a draft. Nothing touches your workspace until you hit Apply — then Logitaka executes exactly the batch you reviewed, with no second AI pass.

items.question: What if it misunderstands me?
items.answer: Corrections happen in place. Say "not tomorrow, Friday" and the card updates. Missing fields show as empty slots you can fill with your next phrase.

items.question: How long is a session?
items.answer: Up to 3 minutes or 8 actions per batch, whichever comes first. Apply, then start a new one.

items.question: Which AI models power it?
items.answer: Logitaka routes requests across 43 active models from 8 providers — including OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Mistral, Alibaba, xAI, Moonshot, and Xiaomi. The system automatically selects the right model based on task complexity, balancing speed and cost.

items.question: Is Logitaka a chatbot?
items.answer: No. Logitaka Talk is a deterministic voice workspace, not a chat interface. When you confirm a batch, Logitaka executes exactly what you reviewed — there is no second AI pass and no reinterpretation at apply time.

items.question: What plans include Talk?
items.answer: Talk is available on every tier — Starter, Pro, and Premium. Inbox, Focus, Discussion, and Structured Meetings are Pro and above. AI Strategist Insights, Personal AI Profiler, and Independent AI Analytics are Premium only.

items.question: How is my data handled?
items.answer: Payments are processed securely via Lemon Squeezy — Logitaka never sees or stores your card details. Have strict compliance needs or want a custom deployment? Contact us at support@logitaka.com.

items.question: Who is Logitaka for?
items.answer: Founders, managers, and freelancers who think faster than they type. If you constantly have more to track than you have time to write down, Talk was built for you.
